title: The silent-undo refusal prints its Drops-lines remedy as a whole commit message, and the lane lint prints the trailer proof to run after the commit
why: Proposal from lane child-ci-degen (degen #706; coordinator 06:36 CST Nov 14, relayed; as data, triage read none of it). Mistake it made: it wrote the `Drops-lines:` remedy line in its own paragraph twice (commits 319f31a07 and e8869badb), so git read no trailer and the scan still refused. Harm: two wasted pushes and ready runs at runner 11; CI on one ran for a head that was replaced (no wall measured). Proposed guard: the check_silent_undo refusal prints its remedy as a complete commit message (subject, then ONE last paragraph holding `Drops-lines: ...` with the Co-Authored-By and Claude-Session lines together), and the lane lint prints `git log -1 --format='%(trailers:key=Drops-lines)'` as the proof to run after the commit. A guard or check change: round 3 applies. Pair with silent-undo-inplace-rewrite (same scan; a lane may take both). Lane pushed 01d375cd01bd with a real trailer. Filed as a step, not a debt: the mistake has happened twice in one PR and a remedy that misleads is likely in normal work. LANE STARTED 06:51 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 06:48, relayed): lane silent-undo-trailer-and-rewrite (session_013NEJL1sQdYhZzBrVywMEdX, Sonnet medium, tracker the coordinator, path ALONE, draft first, branch slug silent-undo-trailer-rewrite, created 12:46Z) takes steps silent-undo-inplace-rewrite and silent-undo-remedy-shows-trailer: one scan. First act: read the guard record and reproduce on the #706 diff, red then green, with a real-drop control. The brief does not say round 3 applies; the merge tool decides (owner item 833 open). CORRECTION 07:30 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 07:30, from runner 11; unread by triage): the scan took the FIRST Drops-lines trailer per path, so on degen #706 it read the old reason ("one sentence, no meaning dropped", commit 01d375cd0); a later reason in the PR body would not have overridden it. The earlier claim that it would was runner 11's read of `allowed`, passed on by the coordinator, and was wrong; moot now (#706 merged, main d37b88bd47d0). The true reason sits only in commit 1fe4944a9. Add to the lane: the scan takes the first trailer per path, so a remedy printed once must be right the first time; test that a second trailer for the same path does not override the first, or change it to read the last (the lane reads the code first). Owner look: the narrowed sentence is now in degen main; triage decided no owner item (ruling push-skip-proven-tree covers it); the coordinator asked that this be named.
